updates.title: Extended essay
updates.summary: Choose a subject-focused or interdisciplinary research pathway. The revised assessment model totals 30 marks. Use the guide for your examination session with your supervisor.

updates.title: Computer science
updates.summary: Two themes connect computing concepts with computational thinking and problem-solving. The new course includes machine learning and a computational solution. Consult the guide for assessment weights.

updates.title: Psychology
updates.summary: Concepts, content and contexts are connected through the course. The internal assessment becomes a research proposal at both SL and HL.

updates.title: Visual arts and design technology
updates.summary: Revised courses are first assessed in May 2027. Follow the relevant course link in the official directory to select your subject brief.

updates.title: History
updates.summary: Paired case studies, global themes and regional in-depth topics reshape the course. Assessment changes begin with May 2028, not the 2027 cohort.

updates.title: Mathematics: AA and AI
updates.summary: The next mathematics courses begin teaching in 2027, with first assessment in May 2029. Earlier cohorts should continue with their existing course guides.

updates.title: Language acquisition and dance
updates.summary: These updates are scheduled for first teaching in 2027 and assessment in May 2029. The directory also lists religion and society.

updates.title: ESS, global politics and SEHS
updates.summary: Updated courses in these subjects are first assessed in May 2026. Select the current subject brief through the official directory.
